1. Twin sprucesTwo tall, properly drawn spruces with glowing eyes in the dark between them. Closest to the current logo, just better drawn.
2. Forest edge, stackedA layered stand of five firs with eyes deep inside it, name stacked below on a ground line. Most "national park sign".
3. Moonlit badgeThe twin spruces in a round badge with a pale moon behind. Works as a sticker, patch and app icon.
